admin.display.title: Display
admin.display.gallery_desc: Choose how photos are presented in the homepage gallery. You can switch layouts at any time. Please note recommended image dimensions when preparing photos:
admin.display.desc_ambient_blur: Calm, harmonious grid with 100% motif visibility. The photograph is fitted without clipping and elegantly framed with a soft blurred colour aura of the original image.
admin.display.rec_ambient_blur: Landscape: 1200 × 900 px (4:3) or Square 1000 × 1000 px. Portrait (e.g. 3:4 or 9:16): at least 1000 px on the longest edge.
admin.display.desc_masonry: Multi-column staggered grid with natural heights. Each image retains its original aspect ratio. Portrait photos appear tall and slender, landscape images compact. No cropping.
admin.display.rec_masonry: Any aspect ratio supported. Recommended image width: 800 – 1400 px (height adapts automatically).
admin.display.desc_editorial: Dynamic editorial grid. Portrait photos automatically span 2 grid rows to become eye-catching highlights, while landscape images fill standard tiles.
admin.display.desc_classic: Strict, uniform grid. All images are cropped precisely to 4:3 aspect ratio.
admin.display.rec_classic: Exactly 1200 × 900 px (4:3 landscape). Key subjects must be centred as edges are cropped.
admin.display.lightbox_desc: Allows visitors to click any gallery image to view it full-screen with high-resolution view, title, description, and navigation arrows.
admin.display.tuning_heading: Gallery Tiles: Corner Rounding & Grid Gap
admin.display.tuning_desc: Fine-tune the geometry of gallery cards and craft tiles to your preference:
admin.display.placement_desc: Define where triggers for the contact form and legal imprint/privacy drawer should appear on your website:
admin.display.arch_desc: Determine how your website is structured. You can switch smoothly between a modern one-pager and a classic multi-page site at any time:
admin.display.arch_onepage_desc: All active content sections (gallery, workshops, blog, downloads, etc.) appear sequentially on the homepage. Navigation links scroll smoothly to section anchors.
admin.display.arch_multipage_desc: Homepage acts as a welcoming introduction. Main sections (gallery, workshops, blog, downloads, etc.) receive dedicated URLs (/?page=gallery) as standalone pages.
admin.display.arch_hybrid_desc: Complete flexibility: configure individually for each section whether it appears on the homepage, as a standalone page, or both.
admin.display.menu_desc: Select the presentation style and position of your website navigation. For vertical sidebars, the menu collapses automatically into a compact mobile header with slide-in drawer on displays <= 992px.
admin.display.sidebar_align_desc: Determine which screen edge the fixed sidebar docks to on desktop displays:
admin.display.a11y_desc: Provide maximum reading comfort for visitors through subtle navigation controls directly in the menu.
admin.display.a11y_label: Display visitor accessibility controls in navigation
admin.display.a11y_info: Subtly embeds live Light/Dark mode controls (🌙/☀️) and font-size scaling (A- / A+) into the navigation bar. Visitor preferences are remembered automatically in their browser.
admin.display.i18n_desc: Enable additional languages for your website. When multiple languages are active, a language switcher appears automatically in the header and mobile drawer.
admin.display.i18n_primary_hint: The primary language serves as baseline content and automatic fallback for incomplete translations.
admin.display.i18n_primary_always_active: The primary language is always active

admin.design.logo_section_desc: Customise the visual identity of your website. Choose your preferred logo type, upload a custom image or SVG logo, adjust the height smoothly, and set a favicon for browser tabs and smartphone home screens.
admin.design.type_text_desc: Classic typographic display of your name/studio without graphics.
admin.design.type_image_desc: Complete company or organisation logo (SVG, PNG, WebP) as header graphic.
admin.design.type_icon_text_desc: Compact logo icon to the left of your company or studio name.
admin.design.type_motif_desc: WeaveCMS paw print and nature motifs with customisable colour.
admin.design.upload_box_desc: Supported file formats: SVG (recommended for crisp vectors), PNG (with transparency), WebP or JPG.
admin.design.logo_height_hint: The width scales proportionally and automatically, ensuring your logo is never distorted.
admin.design.favicon_desc: The favicon appears in the browser tab, in bookmarks, and as a touch icon on mobile devices. Supported formats are .ico, .svg, or .png.
admin.design.motif_desc: Choose the matching SVG nature motif for your website:
admin.design.motif_none_desc: Do not use an SVG motif.
admin.design.position_desc: Choose where the logo or icon should be positioned:
admin.design.pos_header_before_desc: Classic placement to the left of the website name in the header.
admin.design.pos_header_after_desc: Directly to the right behind the website name in the header.
admin.design.pos_hero_before_desc: Centred above the large main heading on the home page.
admin.design.pos_hero_after_desc: Centred directly below the large main heading.
admin.design.system_desc: Customise the visual appearance of your website. Choose one of the harmonious nature colour themes (1-click) or fine-tune colours, container width, and font scales according to your preferences.
admin.design.themes_desc: Clicking a colour theme automatically selects the matching primary, accent, and background colours.
admin.design.theme_classic_desc: The proven original design: gentle natural linen, forest green, and warm willow tone.
admin.design.theme_moor_desc: Warm earthy tones: soft sand beach, deep moss brown, and sunny amber.
admin.design.theme_nordic_desc: Tranquil and subtle: Scandinavian light grey, delicate sage green, and slate.
admin.design.theme_terracotta_desc: Artistic & cosy: ivory, terracotta, and dark wood.
admin.design.theme_custom_desc: Freely composed colour palette using the colour pickers below.
admin.design.finetune_desc: Fine-tune individual colours as required. As soon as a colour is manually adjusted, the theme switches automatically to 'Custom'.
admin.design.bg_color_desc: Base tone of the entire website
admin.design.width_desc: Specifies how wide the content area may expand on large displays:
admin.design.width_compact_desc: Focused reading flow with calm, centred aesthetics.
admin.design.width_default_desc: Balanced ratio between visual impact and readability.
admin.design.width_wide_desc: Expansive studio layout for modern high-resolution displays.
admin.design.scale_desc: Scales all copy, headings, and line heights fluidly across the entire layout.
admin.design.scale_compact_desc: Slightly more understated typography for a delicate look.
admin.design.scale_default_desc: Perfectly balanced reading size conforming to web standards.
admin.design.scale_large_desc: Gentle on the eyes and exceptionally legible.
admin.security.captcha_desc: Select the desired anti-spam method for your contact form. All methods are 100% GDPR-compliant without external trackers.
admin.security.mode_icons_desc: Click selection from 4 nature and craft symbols. The proven WeaveCMS standard.
admin.security.mode_math_desc: Dynamic random arithmetic challenge (e.g. '4 + 3 = ?'). Simple and highly accessible.
admin.security.mode_canvas_desc: 5-digit code rendered in canvas with noise lines. Immune to text scrapers.
admin.security.mode_honeypot_desc: Honeypot trap + time trap without any visible question. Maximum convenience for visitors.
admin.security.icons_selection_desc: Select exactly 4 of the 12 available symbols:
admin.security.impressum_email_title: 🛡️ Protect Legal Notice email address with active captcha verification (Anti-scraping)
admin.security.impressum_email_desc: Prevents automated address harvesters and spam crawlers from reading your Legal Notice email address in plain text. Visitors reveal the address with a click and a 5-digit canvas code.
admin.security.contact_email_title: 🛡️ Protect contact area email address with active captcha verification (Anti-scraping)
admin.security.contact_email_desc: Protects the direct contact email address in the contact menu from spam harvesters. Visitors reveal the address with a click and a 5-digit canvas code (the contact form remains fully operational).
admin.security.smtp_desc: Configure server email dispatch for your contact form. When SMTP is enabled, emails are dispatched with authentication via your mailbox (highest reliability against spam filters). Otherwise, your web host's standard PHP mail function is used.
admin.security.smtp_enable_label: Enable authenticated SMTP dispatch (Recommended for live servers & mailboxes)
admin.security.smtp_from_email_hint: Leave blank to use the username email address.
admin.security.upload_dir_label: Storage directory for uploaded images (relative to web root)
admin.security.upload_dir_hint: Default: images/uploads or uploads. Directories are created automatically if required.
admin.security.prod_desc: Advanced security options for live internet operations (Apache / Nginx with SSL certificate and reverse proxies).
admin.security.hsts_title: 🔒 Enable strict HSTS policy & SSL preloading (Phase 17.1)
admin.security.hsts_desc: Sends the header Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload (active only on existing HTTPS connections). Enforces 100% encrypted connections on modern browsers.
admin.security.csp_title: 🛡️ Enable hardened production CSP (Content Security Policy) (Phase 17.2)
admin.security.csp_desc: Protects your website from cross-site scripting (XSS) and unauthorised loading of external resources by strictly restricting to trusted first-party domains and curated Google Fonts.
admin.security.proxies_title: 🌐 Trusted Reverse Proxies & Cloudflare IPs (Anti-spoofing - Phase 17.4)
admin.security.proxies_hint: Comma-separated list of upstream proxy IPs or CIDR blocks. X-Forwarded-For and CF-Connecting-IP are only accepted from these IP addresses to prevent IP spoofing during rate limiting and audit logging.
admin.security.alert_title: 🚨 Immediate email alert on brute-force lockouts (Phase 17.5)
admin.security.alert_desc: Automatically dispatches an alert email to the administrator whenever an IP address is locked out due to repeated failed attempts.
admin.security.alert_cooldown_hint: Prevents email spam during prolonged attacks.
admin.security.smtp_test_desc: Dispatch a test email to verify your saved SMTP credentials immediately (please save above first).
admin.security.audit_desc: Audits file access permissions for sensitive configuration files, data stores, and directories against unauthorised reading or writing.
admin.security.backup_desc: Back up all website content and uploaded images with a single click. All backups are archived in the protected backups/ directory on the server (shielded from direct access via .htaccess) and can be downloaded or restored at any time.
admin.security.opt_backup_full: Option B: Full Archive incl. Images (.zip)
admin.security.backup_recommendation: 💡 {rec} Regularly create a full ZIP archive prior to major content modifications or updates.
admin.security.pkg_desc: Creates clean ZIP packages under releases/ (excluding customer data, logs, and git folders) for server transfers (e.g. WeaveCMS_ownsite).
admin.security.backups_empty:
There are no backup files in the backups/ directory yet.
Click 1-Click Backup above to create your first backup.
admin.security.confirm_delete_backup: Are you sure you want to permanently delete this backup file?
admin.security.upload_restore_desc: Here you can upload a previously downloaded ZIP or JSON backup file from your computer. To protect against accidental overwrites, confirmation with your administrator PIN is required. A safety snapshot is automatically created prior to restoring.
admin.security.confirm_restore_upload: Warning: Restoring will overwrite all current data with the contents of the file. Do you wish to proceed?
admin.security.cred_desc: Change your personal password and PIN code for login here. Leave the fields blank if you do not wish to change them. To protect your administration area, entering your currently valid PIN is strictly required before applying changes.
admin.security.cred_warning_text: For security reasons, entering your currently valid PIN is strictly required before any change to your password or PIN! Without the correct current PIN, new entries will be rejected.
admin.security.current_pin_hint: Strictly required to activate a new password or new PIN.
admin.security.new_password_hint: Only fill in if you wish to set a new password.
admin.security.new_pin_hint: Only fill in if you wish to set a new PIN.
admin.security.storage_desc: Choose freely between Flat-File JSON and relational MySQL/MariaDB databases with seamless 1-click data transfer.
admin.security.fallback_warning: ⚠️ Emergency fallback active: The configured database could not be reached; WeaveCMS is temporarily using the local data.json.
admin.security.mig_to_mysql_title: Migrate from Flat-File JSON to MySQL / MariaDB
admin.security.mig_to_mysql_desc: Transfers all current content, settings, and appointments into a relational MySQL database. A safety backup of your data.json is automatically created prior to migration.
admin.security.confirm_mig_mysql: Do you want to migrate all data into the MySQL database now and enable MySQL?
admin.security.create_db_label: Create database automatically if not already existing
admin.security.mig_to_json_desc: Exports all current data from the MySQL database completely into the local file data/data.json and removes the SQL configuration. WeaveCMS will then run self-sufficiently without a database.
admin.security.confirm_mig_json: Do you want to back up all content from MySQL into data.json and switch to flat-file operation?

admin.custom_fields.title: Custom Fields & Attributes
admin.custom_fields.desc: Define cross-module structured data fields (e.g. subtitle, reading time, external links, or metrics). These fields appear automatically in the editor of each module and can be output in the frontend.
admin.custom_fields.table_hint: Configured custom fields for this module:
admin.custom_fields.empty: No custom fields defined for this module yet. Click on “Add New Field”.
admin.custom_fields.hint_persist: Changes will be saved to the CMS once you click Save.
